 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Denver Broncos may have learned a lesson from 2025, when they balked at trading for Miami Dolphins wide receiver Jaylen Waddle — a decision that may have cost them a Super Bowl spot.
 Don't expect any such reticence in 2026 — ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport named the Broncos as one of the teams circling a trade with the Indianapolis Colts for NFL All-Pro running back Jonathan Taylor ahead of the November 10 NFL trade deadline.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Schefter and Rapoport reported that the Broncos, Green Bay Packers, Seattle Seahawks, and Minnesota Vikings are chasing Taylor. The Athletic's Jonathan Jones added the New York Giants to the list of "possible suitors."
 According to Rapoport, the Colts are 2-4 and face a "three-game season" that will determine whether they are indeed sellers at the trade deadline.
 "The Green Bay Packers, Seattle Seahawks, Denver Broncos and Vikings are among the teams that have pondered, or are expected to consider, the possibility of a trade for the star running back, according to sources," Schefter and Rapoport wrote on Sunday morning.
